name: Water
chemical_properties: Polar molecule; forms hydrogen bonds; amphoteric (can act as acid or base); excellent solvent for ionic compounds.
safety: Not hazardous. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Sodium chloride
chemical_properties: Ionic solid (Na⁺Cl⁻); conducts electricity when molten or dissolved; solution is neutral.
safety: Low hazard; may irritate eyes. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Ethanol
chemical_properties: Primary alcohol; burns with a pale blue flame; can be oxidised to ethanal and ethanoic acid.
safety: Highly flammable liquid and vapour; causes serious eye irritation. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Methanol
description: Toxic; used as fuel and solvent.
chemical_properties: Simplest alcohol; burns with an almost invisible flame.
safety: Highly flammable; toxic if swallowed, inhaled or absorbed through skin; damages the optic nerve. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Methane
chemical_properties: Simplest alkane; tetrahedral; undergoes combustion and free-radical substitution.
safety: Extremely flammable gas; asphyxiant in high concentration. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Ethane
chemical_properties: Saturated hydrocarbon (alkane); relatively unreactive apart from combustion.
safety: Extremely flammable gas. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Propane
chemical_properties: Alkane; main component of LPG; burns cleanly to CO₂ and H₂O.
safety: Extremely flammable gas; stored under pressure. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Butane
chemical_properties: Alkane; exists as two isomers (n-butane and isobutane).
safety: Extremely flammable gas; stored under pressure. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Hexane
chemical_properties: Non-polar alkane solvent.
safety: Highly flammable; neurotoxic with long exposure; aspiration hazard. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Octane
chemical_properties: Alkane; isomer 2,2,4-trimethylpentane defines the octane rating of 100.
safety: Highly flammable; aspiration hazard. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Ethylene
chemical_properties: Simplest alkene; C=C double bond undergoes addition and polymerisation.
safety: Extremely flammable gas. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Acetylene
bp_note: Sublimes at −84 °C (1 atm); no liquid phase at 1 atm
chemical_properties: Alkyne with a C≡C triple bond; very high flame temperature with oxygen.
safety: Extremely flammable; can decompose explosively under pressure. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Benzene
chemical_properties: Aromatic ring with delocalised π electrons; prefers substitution over addition.
safety: Highly flammable; known human carcinogen; toxic. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Toluene
chemical_properties: Methylbenzene; aromatic solvent.
safety: Highly flammable; harmful vapour; suspected reproductive toxicant. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Naphthalene
chemical_properties: Two fused benzene rings; sublimes slowly at room temperature.
safety: Flammable solid; harmful if swallowed; suspected carcinogen. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Acetone
chemical_properties: Simplest ketone (propanone); polar aprotic solvent.
safety: Highly flammable; causes eye irritation; vapour may cause drowsiness. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Acetic acid
chemical_properties: Weak carboxylic acid (pKa ≈ 4.76); reacts with bases and carbonates.
safety: Glacial acid is flammable and causes severe skin burns. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Formaldehyde
chemical_properties: Simplest aldehyde (methanal); readily polymerises.
safety: Toxic; known human carcinogen; skin sensitiser. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Diethyl ether
chemical_properties: Ether; very volatile; can form explosive peroxides on storage.
safety: Extremely flammable; may cause drowsiness. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Chloroform
chemical_properties: Trichloromethane; dense, non-flammable solvent.
safety: Harmful if swallowed or inhaled; suspected carcinogen. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Phenol
chemical_properties: Weakly acidic aromatic alcohol (pKa ≈ 10).
safety: Toxic; causes severe skin burns; absorbed through skin. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Glycerol
chemical_properties: Triol (three –OH groups); hygroscopic and viscous.
safety: Low hazard. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Ethylene glycol
chemical_properties: Diol; lowers the freezing point of water (antifreeze).
safety: Harmful if swallowed – toxic to kidneys. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Urea
chemical_properties: Carbonyl diamide; first organic compound synthesised from inorganic material (Wöhler, 1828).
safety: Low hazard. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Glucose
chemical_properties: Monosaccharide (aldohexose); reducing sugar.
safety: Not hazardous. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Sucrose
chemical_properties: Disaccharide of glucose and fructose; non-reducing sugar.
safety: Not hazardous. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Aspirin
chemical_properties: Acetylsalicylic acid; ester and carboxylic acid groups; hydrolyses in moist air.
safety: Harmful if swallowed. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Caffeine
chemical_properties: Purine alkaloid; mild base.
safety: Harmful if swallowed in large amounts. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Ammonia
chemical_properties: Weak base; lone pair makes it a ligand; trigonal pyramidal shape.
safety: Toxic if inhaled; corrosive to skin and eyes. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Carbon dioxide
mp_note: Does not melt at 1 atm (triple point −56.6 °C at 5.1 atm)
chemical_properties: Linear molecule; acidic oxide – forms carbonic acid in water.
safety: Asphyxiant in high concentration; dry ice causes cold burns. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Carbon monoxide
chemical_properties: Binds strongly to haemoglobin; good reducing agent in metallurgy.
safety: Extremely flammable; highly toxic, odourless gas. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Nitrogen dioxide
chemical_properties: Brown gas in equilibrium with colourless N₂O₄; forms nitric acid in water.
safety: Very toxic if inhaled; strong oxidiser. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Sulfur dioxide
chemical_properties: Acidic oxide; reducing agent; used as a food preservative (E220).
safety: Toxic if inhaled; respiratory irritant. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Hydrogen sulfide
chemical_properties: Weak acid in water; smells of rotten eggs at low levels.
safety: Extremely flammable; very toxic – deadens the sense of smell at high concentration. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Ozone
chemical_properties: Allotrope of oxygen; very strong oxidising agent.
safety: Toxic respiratory irritant; strong oxidiser. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Hydrogen peroxide
bp_note: Value for the pure compound; decomposes on heating
chemical_properties: Decomposes to water and oxygen (catalysed by MnO₂); oxidising and reducing agent.
safety: Concentrated solutions are corrosive and strongly oxidising. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Sulfuric acid
chemical_properties: Strong diprotic acid; powerful dehydrating agent.
safety: Causes severe skin burns and eye damage. Always add acid to water, never water to acid. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Hydrogen chloride
chemical_properties: Strong acid in water; fumes in moist air.
safety: Toxic if inhaled; causes severe burns. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Nitric acid
description: Used for fertilisers and explosives industry.
chemical_properties: Strong acid and strong oxidising agent.
safety: Causes severe burns; oxidiser; toxic fumes. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Sodium hydroxide
chemical_properties: Strong base; saponifies fats; absorbs CO₂ from air.
safety: Causes severe skin burns and eye damage. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Potassium hydroxide
chemical_properties: Strong base; deliquescent.
safety: Causes severe skin burns and eye damage. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Potassium chloride
chemical_properties: Ionic salt; source of potassium in fertilisers.
safety: Low hazard. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Calcium chloride
chemical_properties: Ionic salt; strongly hygroscopic – used as a drying agent.
safety: Causes serious eye irritation. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Calcium carbonate
mp_note: Decomposes to CaO + CO₂ around 825 °C before melting at 1 atm
chemical_properties: Reacts with acids releasing CO₂; main component of limestone, marble and chalk.
safety: Low hazard. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Silver nitrate
chemical_properties: Gives a white AgCl precipitate with chloride ions; light sensitive.
safety: Oxidiser; causes severe burns; stains skin. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Potassium permanganate
chemical_properties: Strong oxidising agent; intense purple solution.
safety: Oxidiser – may intensify fire; harmful if swallowed. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Magnesium oxide
chemical_properties: Basic oxide; very high melting point (refractory).
safety: Low hazard. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Silicon dioxide
mp_note: Value for cristobalite; quartz converts before melting
chemical_properties: Giant covalent network; very hard and chemically resistant.
safety: Fine crystalline silica dust is harmful to lungs. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Aluminium oxide
chemical_properties: Amphoteric oxide; very hard (corundum, Mohs 9).
safety: Low hazard. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).

name: Iron(III) oxide
chemical_properties: Basic oxide; reduced to iron by carbon monoxide in a blast furnace.
safety: Low hazard. Summary only – always read the official Safety Data Sheet (SDS).
